summary: One-frame event born when an item enters a player's inventory (potion, thrown dagger picked back up by Osi.ToInventory, containers, dialogue rewards). Consumed by Toolkit esv::inventory::NewInventoryMemberSystem::NewItemsUpdate (EoCServer.dll+0xF05E50, Added query) and by esv::notification::System, which produces eoc::notification::NewMemberAddedToPlayerInventoryNotificationComponent. Registered with size 8, no destructor (bg3.exe+0x34A2C00).

fields.name: field_0
fields.evidence: 8 bytes, trivial (bg3.exe+0x34A2C00). Live: entity handles, one of them the host character 0x7C3 (others in the 0x02000000 high range). Whether it is the receiving character/inventory or the item is not established from code.

open_questions: Meaning of the handle (player character / inventory vs added item).
